note.value:
Range: The Ironfist uses the 12" bolt template. The Ironfist may only target ships at Long range.
Long range is 6" to 12"
To Hit: If your target is in range and unobstructed, place a 1" template on the target. If your target is in range but obstructed roll a d6; 1: falls short by d6"; 2-5: hits the target; 6: goes long by d6"; place the 1" template where the shot hits. In either case all ships under the template take a 1 die high Catapult attack.
Catapult: Catapults always aim high. A target hit by a Catapult may take damage in multiple locations as the projectile falls through the ship from above. If a location is damaged, also roll to see if the location below is damaged with a +1 saving throw (cumulative). If there is a choice between two locations, roll a die; 1-3 hits the left, 4-6 hits the right. If the location is already damaged, the projectile falls through and does not incur an additional +1 saving throw. In this way a catapult shot might fall all the way through a ship.
Boarding Action: The Ironfist may not repel boarders.
